record.paper_title: Spin-density-functional theory: some open problems and application to inhomogeneous Heisenberg models
record.context_brief: Exact energies for 4x4 impurity Heisenberg lattices
record.original_question: What are the exact ground-state energies for four-by-four open-boundary square Heisenberg lattices of spin-one-half sites with a single substitutional impurity spin at a corner, on a side, or in the interior, for impurity spin values one, three-halves, two, and five-halves, so that local-spin-approximation spin-wave estimates for those inhomogeneous lattices can be benchmarked against exact values?

evidence.quote: Next we consider 4 × 4 square lattices with an impurity of spin SI at the corner, at one side, or in the interior of the lattice. Here we use open boundary condition and thus even without impurity the systems are inhomogeneous.

The first column is for SI = 1/2, i.e., for the uniform system, and the value listed differs 6.6% from the exact value e0 = − 0.574325 obtained from numerical diagonalization; we believe the values for other impurity spins are within this accuracy, although no exact values are available, as far as we know.

Table 1: LSA-SW ground-state energy − E0/N J of a 4 × 4 square lattice of S = 1/2 sites with a substitutional impurity of spin SI at the corner (four equivalent positions), on a side (eight equivalent positions) or in the interior of the lattice (four equivalent positions).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg Hamiltonian on a 4×4 square lattice with open boundary conditions, where 15 of the sites carry spin S = 1/2 and a single substitutional impurity site carries spin S_I. The Hamiltonian is

  H = J Σ_{⟨i,j⟩} S_i · S_j,    J > 0,

where the sum runs over nearest-neighbor pairs of sites on the 4×4 grid (each site coupled to its 2, 3, or 4 neighbors depending on its position), and S_i are quantum spin operators of magnitude S = 1/2 at the regular sites and magnitude S_I at the impurity site.

For each of the three inequivalent impurity positions on the 4×4 open lattice — (a) a corner site (4 equivalent positions), (b) an edge site that is not a corner (8 equivalent positions), and (c) an interior site (4 equivalent positions) — and for each impurity spin value S_I ∈ {1, 3/2, 2, 5/2}, determine the exact ground-state energy E_0 of H (equivalently, the dimensionless quantity −E_0/(NJ) with N = 16).

That is, provide the 12 exact ground-state eigenvalues of the smallest eigenvalue of H for these inhomogeneous spin systems, suitable for benchmarking approximate spin-wave or local-spin-approximation calculations.
artifact.status_search_result: No published source providing the 12 exact ground-state energies for these specific impurity Heisenberg 4×4 systems was located. The original formulation explicitly notes that no exact values are available to the authors' knowledge, and no subsequent computation of these particular benchmarks was found via web search.
